core: Plasma lipoprotein metabolism and cholesterol efflux
qualifier: chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL assembly, remodeling and clearance
name: Lipoprotein assembly, remodeling, clearance and cholesterol efflux
rationale: All members concern lipoprotein particle assembly, remodeling, clearance, intestinal lipid absorption or LXR/ABCA1-driven cholesterol efflux; unlike confusables (foam-cell/oxLDL uptake, ABCG5/8 and bile transporter defects) it spans the full chylomicron-VLDL-LDL-HDL particle lifecycle.

qualifier: downstream of NOD1/2 bacterial sensing
name: NOD1/2 bacterial sensing and JNK/p38 stress kinase signaling
rationale: Members cover NOD1/NOD2, ALPK1 and peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide sensing feeding TAK1-mediated JNK and p38 activation and their regulation; confusables are TLR/IRAK/TRIF- and NF-kB-centred instead.

qualifier: commissural and retinal ganglion cell axons
name: Commissural and retinal ganglion cell axon midline guidance
rationale: Members concern repulsive (SLIT-ROBO, negative chemotaxis) guidance of commissural and retinal ganglion cell axons at midline choice points and optic nerve formation; confusables lack the optic nerve/RGC members and add ephrin, netrin and L1 signaling.

qualifier: via L1-family CAM-ankyrin binding
name: Node of Ranvier organization via L1-family CAM–ankyrin binding
rationale: Members (neurofascin, NrCAM and L1-ankyrin interactions, sodium channel clustering, paranodal junction assembly, action potential propagation) all build axonal nodal domains; confusables are gap junctions, other neural adhesion molecules or myelination.

qualifier: postsynaptic assembly and presynaptic choline/acetylcholine supply
name: Neuromuscular junction assembly and presynaptic acetylcholine supply
rationale: Most members concern neuromuscular synapse assembly (AChR clustering, DGC, ECM proteoglycans, terminal organization) and SLC5A7 choline uptake, acetylcholine synthesis and release; confusables center on nicotinic receptor subtypes, clostridial toxins or myasthenic glycosylation defects (bile acid transport is an outlier).

qualifier: modulation by microbes
name: Necroptosis and its modulation by microbes
rationale: All three members concern RIPK1/RIPK3-driven necroptotic death and its manipulation by pathogens including SARS-CoV-1; confusables are pyroptotic inflammasomes or caspase-8 extrinsic apoptosis.

qualifier: social, reproductive and locomotor rather than drug-reward or neuropeptide
name: Innate social, reproductive and locomotor behaviors
rationale: Members are innate behaviors (aggression, parental, female mating, grooming, exploration, swimming, psychomotor) plus amygdala development; confusables concern drug responses, conditioning, dopamine and neuropeptide signaling.

qualifier: glucagon-PKA and LXR-driven
name: Glucagon-PKA and LXR control of triglyceride turnover
rationale: Members combine glucagon/PKA/PDE3B signaling and LXR (NR1H2/3) gene regulation acting on lipogenesis, lipolysis and triglyceride balance; confusables lack the glucagon-PKA arm and emphasize adipogenesis, glucose sensing or insulin secretion.

qualifier: including transport and FMO trimethylamine oxidation
name: Carnitine, choline and biotin metabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover carnitine synthesis/transport, choline catabolism with FMO3 trimethylamine oxidation, biotin recycling and ubiquinol synthesis; confusables are thiamin/riboflavin vitamins, amino acid catabolism or mitochondrial beta-oxidation.

qualifier: adipocyte differentiation and lipid droplet triglyceride dynamics
name: Adipocyte differentiation and lipid droplet triglyceride storage
rationale: Members span white/brown/beige adipocyte differentiation, thermogenesis, triglyceride synthesis and lipolysis and lipid droplet formation, fusion and lipophagy; confusables lack lipid droplet/TAG synthesis members or adipocyte differentiation, or are insulin-centred.

qualifier: cochlear stereocilia
name: Cochlear hair cell stereocilia and sound mechanotransduction
rationale: All members concern cochlear hair cell stereocilia and transduction of sound; confusables are photoreceptors, vestibular function or inner ear morphogenesis.

qualifier: aquaglyceroporin glycerol transport
name: Glycerol metabolism, aquaglyceroporin transport and acylglycerol synthesis
rationale: Members cover glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate and alditol metabolism, aquaporin glycerol (and urea) transport and PA/DAG/TAG synthesis; confusables lack the glycerol transport arm and center on lipolysis, lipid droplets or fructose disorders.

qualifier: promotion of differentiation, fusion and regeneration
name: Promotion of myoblast differentiation, fusion and muscle regeneration
rationale: All members positively regulate myoblast differentiation, fusion or satellite-cell-driven regeneration; confusables include negative regulation, proliferation, migration, fate commitment or atrophy.

qualifier: plateau and potassium-channel repolarization
name: Cardiac action potential plateau and potassium-channel repolarization
rationale: Members concern cardiac action potential phases 1-4, voltage-gated, Kir and TWIK potassium channels and atrial/ventricular repolarization; confusables emphasize depolarization, conduction system and gap junctions or calcium handling and contraction.

qualifier: ligand secretion and non-canonical Ca2+ branch
name: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling
rationale: Members cover PORCN-dependent Wnt biogenesis and secretion and WNT5A/Ca2+ non-canonical signaling; confusables are planar cell polarity, vascular WNT5A-FZD4 or Hedgehog processing.

qualifier: lysine and arginine residues including p53
name: Protein lysine and arginine methylation, including p53
rationale: All members are peptidyl lysine/arginine methylation including p53 methylation; confusables are histone/DNA methylation complexes, hydroxylation or acetylation.

core: DNA damage G2 checkpoint and p53 regulation
qualifier: with AKT signaling
name: DNA damage G2 checkpoint, p53 regulation and AKT signaling
rationale: Members concern radiation responses, G2 checkpoint/Cdc25A degradation, p53 phosphorylation and degradation, senescence and AKT/PI3K signaling; confusables lack the AKT members and center on p53 transcriptional arrest or G2/M cyclin events.

qualifier: selenoprotein synthesis and protein repair
name: Selenium metabolism and selenoprotein-based antioxidant defense
rationale: Members cover selenium compound metabolism, selenocysteine synthesis via translational readthrough, ROS detoxification and methionine sulfoxide protein repair; confusables are sulfur/glutathione, NADPH/ascorbate or thyroid hormone pathways.

qualifier: ER targeting, folding and quality control
name: ER protein targeting, folding, quality control and export
rationale: Members cover SRP/tail-anchored ER insertion, ER folding, ERAD/ERQC, ER retention and COPII/COPI ER-Golgi traffic; confusables lack the targeting/folding/QC members or center on Golgi, endosome and Rab traffic.

qualifier: heparan sulfate and heparin chains
name: Heparan sulfate and heparin chain biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern heparan sulfate/heparin chain synthesis including EXT1/EXT2 exostosis defects; confusables are linkage-region, chondroitin/dermatan sulfate or O-fucose/glucose glycosylation.

qualifier: reuptake and vesicular loading including glycinergic
name: Amino acid neurotransmitter reuptake and vesicular loading
rationale: Members concern SLC transporter reuptake of glutamate, GABA and glycine, astrocytic glutamate uptake and vesicular neurotransmitter loading; confusables add GABA synthesis/degradation and aspartate transport and lack glycinergic and vesicular-loading members.

qualifier: phosphorylation-driven APC/C activation
name: Phosphorylation-activated APC/C degradation driving mitotic exit
rationale: Members concern APC/C phosphorylation and activation and its degradation of Nek2A, cyclin A and Cdc20 during mitotic exit; confusables center on cyclin B/securin at metaphase-anaphase, APC/C inhibition or Emi1/Cdc6 control.

qualifier: progenitor division, neuronal migration and commissure formation
name: Cortical neurogenesis, neuronal migration and forebrain commissure formation
rationale: Members cover forebrain progenitor and asymmetric neuroblast division, radial and tangential neuron migration, cortical layering and commissure/tract morphogenesis; confusables are reelin/dendrite, cerebellar or neural tube/spinal patterning themes.

qualifier: SUMO processing, E1-E2 conjugation and desumoylation
name: SUMO conjugation cycle and nuclear protein SUMOylation
rationale: Members cover SUMO maturation, E1/E2 transfer, desumoylation and SUMOylation of nuclear substrates (replication, repair, transcription, nuclear envelope); confusables lack the conjugation-cycle members or concern PML bodies and nuclear pore traffic.

qualifier: NLRP3/NLRP1 and pro-inflammatory cytokine regulation
name: NLRP3/NLRP1 inflammasome IL-1 processing and inflammatory cytokine regulation
rationale: Members concern NLRP3/NLRP1 inflammasomes, IL-1 processing and regulation of IL-1, IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production; confusables center on pyroptosis, AIM2/CASP4/5 and IL-18, TLR-negative regulation or chemokines.
